## Où j'en suis
The replay tool shipped: PR #233 was approved and merged, and the real replay of the 2026-11-12 window ran to completion — 18,442,107 events produced to `events.replay.v3`, 3,118 schema-v2 lines diverted to the rejects file in S3 (source: r2-01, r2-04, ses-rp-2). The aggregator backfill `backfill-2026-11-12` started at 08:57 UTC and was at ~61% after 55 minutes, with ~14.9M rows in `events_v3` for the incident window against ~20.5M expected; the incident is still open (source: r2-06, r2-07).

- [en-cours] Aggregator backfill for 2026-11-12 reading `events.replay.v3`, hours 15–23 still to go (source: r2-06, ses-rp-2)
- [prochaine-étape] Wait for the backfill to reach 100%, then compare ClickHouse counts hour by hour (1% tolerance) against the previous week (source: r2-08, r2-10)
- [prochaine-étape] Close the incident only once the counts match (source: r2-07)
- [essai-raté] 50k batches OOMKilled (exit 137, 2Gi limit) on the dry run; 5k batches work at ~310 MiB peak — memory limit must not be raised (source: r1-03, r1-04, src-sentry-oom)
- [décision] Replay everything into a separate topic `events.replay.v3` read by the aggregator with `--backfill`; never produce to `events.v3` from this tool (source: r1-02, src-slack-incident)
- [décision] Batch size 5k, namespace memory quota left alone (source: r1-04)
- [décision] Fork PR #241 is to be ignored; the official fix is Daniel's CI check on the dedup key builder (source: r2-09, src-slack-incident)
